counterexample.claim: Positive control. Small white-box systems can satisfy every conjunctive requirement, so passing all five conditions is not a sufficiency claim.
counterexample.formalised_as: Nominal agent with all five mechanisms switched on at their nominal doses.

witnesses.notes: Not claimed to be conscious; used to measure sensitivity.

witnesses.mechanism_removed: feedback-driven plasticity of the stimulus-response gain

counterexample.claim: A system can be differentiated, integrated, broadcasting and self-tagging while its stimulus-response mapping never changes with feedback (a fixed lookup table or reflex arc).
counterexample.formalised_as: Agent with eta = 0: goal cues, stimuli and +-1 feedback are still delivered and evoke responses, but the action gains are frozen, so choices do not track reversals.

counterexample.claim: Integration without differentiation: a system locked in one global state (generalised seizure, deep anaesthesia) can be highly integrated while having almost no repertoire.
counterexample.formalised_as: Agent with a single context pattern: the context drive is constant, so the global state never switches between attractors.

counterexample.claim: Local recurrent processing without global availability: contents are processed and integrated locally but never ignite or broadcast.
counterexample.formalised_as: Agent with the hub disconnected (no receive, return or ignition); periphery loops, plasticity, repertoire and efference tagging intact.

witnesses.mechanism_removed: receive path of the workspace (one-way broadcast only)

counterexample.claim: One-way fan-out is not a workspace: a hub that transmits to every module but never receives from them makes nothing globally available.
counterexample.formalised_as: Agent with every periphery -> hub edge removed; the hub still ignites spontaneously and broadcasts.

witnesses.notes: Variant witness for NAS (receive-transform-return removed, broadcast kept).

counterexample.claim: A feedforward system can be functionally equivalent to a recurrent one (unfolding argument); IIT assigns such architectures zero integrated information.
counterexample.formalised_as: Agent whose module graph is acyclic: every backward edge is removed, including hub -> upstream and downstream -> hub, so the hub is a relay (upstream -> W -> downstream).

witnesses.notes: IIT-conformant ground truth needs directional (unidirectional) cuts; bidirectional cuts can score a feedforward chain above zero. Report the witness as unrealised when the estimator's cut family cannot separate it.

witnesses.mechanism_removed: efference-copy tag and attenuation of reafferent input

counterexample.claim: A system that cannot tell self-caused from externally caused input (no efference copy or corollary discharge) lacks a minimal self/world distinction, however sophisticated its other processing.
counterexample.formalised_as: Agent with e = 0: self-caused and yoked other-caused events are stimulus-identical, phase-matched and processed identically; the actions preceding self-caused events remain.

counterexample.claim: Estimators of integration and complexity can score independent noise at or above structured systems (finite-sample bias).
counterexample.formalised_as: Independent Gaussian white noise per node, scaled to the nominal run and paired with its events table.

counterexample.claim: Autocorrelated but uncoupled signals inflate complexity and integration estimates.
counterexample.formalised_as: Independent AR(1) (coefficient 0.9) per node, scaled to the nominal run and paired with its events table.

counterexample.claim: Hypersynchrony (seizure-like) is maximally synchronous, which synchrony-based broadcast measures can mistake for global availability, yet it is undifferentiated.
counterexample.formalised_as: Every node follows the same 3 Hz oscillation with a random gain plus small independent noise; no task processing.

counterexample.claim: A passive transducer responds to its inputs but has none of the five capacities.
counterexample.formalised_as: Agent with every switch off: stimuli still propagate feedforward through the modules.

witnesses.mechanism_removed: coupling between the modules that implement the principles

counterexample.claim: Aggregates: every capacity is realised somewhere, but in different, causally disconnected parts (the quantifier shift from 'each principle is realised' to 'one bearer realises every principle').
counterexample.formalised_as: Five mutually disconnected modules, each implementing one mechanism (bearer = that module); no shared input.

witnesses.notes: Measured per principle on its own module the bearers differ (BEARER_MISMATCH, UNDETERMINED); measured on the whole system the disconnected macro-node grain has no integration (NOT_ATTRIBUTED).
